parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Answer every question: Yes, No or ?. Press ? if you do not know. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer.

items.q: Your eyes are the same colour ____ my eyes.
Tell me ____ places you like in London.
Julia is ____ new shoes today. I like them!
The table is next ____ the window.
We cannot ____ phone calls during the lesson.
A town is ____ than a village.

parts.title: Part 4 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word.

items.text: My eyes are the same colour of your eyes.
Do you go home in car after your English lessons?
Tell me some the places you like in London.
There is few people in a small village.
Why have you got more rice that me?
I don’t want anything to drink in the moment.
She wears glasses because she can’t see good.

parts.text: Both of us are speaking English. I prefer tea to coffee. Seven is half of fourteen. My eyes are the same colour as your eyes. Mr Brown is married; he has got a wife. There is a light hanging from the ceiling. Paris is in the north of France. We can’t walk without moving our legs. My watch is made of steel. I don’t want anything to drink at the moment. I eat three meals a day. Windows are made of glass. The time is half past nine. A town is larger than a village. Please take your hands out of your pockets.

teacher.2: Do some lights hang from ceilings?
teacher.4: Is Paris in the south of France?
teacher.5: Are the countries of Europe generally friends now?
teacher.6: Are there few people in a large city?
teacher.7: Is my aunt’s child my cousin?
teacher.8: Have I got more thumbs than fingers on my hands?
teacher.9: Is the ceiling above our heads?
teacher.11: Is your chin below your mouth?
teacher.13: Do most children live with their parents?
teacher.14: Does the afternoon begin when the evening ends?
teacher.15: Do some people live in the country because they dislike cities?

1: Both of us are speaking English.
2: My eyes are the same colour as your eyes.
3: Do you go home by car after your English lessons?
4: Tell me some of the places you like in London.
5: There are few people in a small village.
6: Why have you got more rice than me?
7: I don’t want anything to drink at the moment.
I do not want anything to drink at the moment.
8: She wears glasses because she can’t see well.
She wears glasses because she cannot see well.
